# BarberHQ

> Multi-location chain showroom for FallHub. Sovereign AI-first OS for barbershop chains and adjacent multi-location small businesses (gyms, cafés, nail bars, salons, yoga studios, beauty clinics, small retail). Central kernel with N location sub-configs · shared services + local hours/staff/stock · walk-in queue + appointment book · loyalty punch card · staff shift shuffling · per-location review response. Published by AI-Native Solutions. MIT. ◊·κ=1.

## What it is

BarberHQ is a vertical showroom pointing at:
- FallHub's barbershop-chain vertical template (also serves the broader multi-location pattern)
- FallForge's concierge installer
- The chain module stack (FallAccount, FallCRM Elite, FallReach, FallSecurity, Botler, Cassie Oracle)

Any multi-location small-business owner can deploy FallHub with the BarberHQ configuration and get an AI-first operating system that handles appointment booking, walk-in queue management, shift shuffling, stock ordering, loyalty tracking, and per-location review responses.

## Signature feature: multi-location chain kernel

BarberHQ's kernel has a central `chain` block (shared services, prices, loyalty rules) plus an array of `locations` (each with hours, chairs, staff, walk-in policy, review platform IDs). Global changes propagate; local changes stay local. Adding a location is one JSON block.

## Pattern extends to

- Fitness studios / gyms (classes replace services)
- Independent cafés (takeout queue)
- Nail bars / salons (near-identical to barbershop)
- Yoga / pilates studios (class-based + trial weeks)
- Beauty clinics (treatments + consult gates)
- Small retail chains (stock primary · no chair)

## Modules typically installed on BarberHQ instances

- FallAccount — multi-location P&L, tips accounting, VAT per location
- FallCRM Elite — customer history across all locations, loyalty tracking
- FallReach — Instagram + TikTok scheduling, cut-of-the-week reels
- FallSecurity — CCTV DPIA, staff DBS records, GDPR for customer photos
- Botler — in-browser LLM for on-tablet drafting during peak hours
- Cassie Oracle — local competitor price watch, foot-traffic patterns
